latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate videos free from text or image prompts.

- Instantly turn text descriptions or image uploads into downloadable 1080p MP4 videos (supports MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG up to 200MB).
- No registration needed: anonymous users receive free credits for 7 days.
- Integrated cloud GPU rendering with processing times of 30–90 seconds per video.
- Supports common video editing actions (add BGM, text overlays, aspect ratio changes, etc.) via chat instructions.
- User flows include uploads, status checks, credit balance, and exports, with clear error handling and status updates.
- Designed for content creators, marketers, and students seeking quick, no-cost video generation.
